architecture: api.rs is protected by an axum middleware chain (rate_limit outer, require_token inner) over /v1, /metrics, /ws. AppState shares auth_token (60s TTL cache via spawn_blocking, Err cached for fail-closed), ws_tickets (one-shot HashMap, atomic remove), and rate_buckets (per-IP token bucket) behind tokio Mutexes. forward passes through for openai-completions (client Authorization is NOT relayed; provider injects its own key) and translates via translate_forward otherwise.

summary: Full security/boundary audit of src/api.rs (1-893) complete. Core paths are largely sound: ws_ticket one-shot semantics (atomic remove at rpc.rs:48-53), auth_token_cache fail-closed on unresolvable/empty tokens, rate_limit ignoring spoofable headers, no client Authorization relayed upstream. 3 Low findings, no Critical/High: (1) raw upstream reqwest errors including internal upstream URLs echoed to clients in 502 bodies and SSE error chunks; (2) constant_time_eq early-returns on length mismatch, leaking token length via timing; (3) rate_buckets eviction does O(n^2) min_by_key scans while holding the shared rate-limit mutex, stalling all gated endpoints under a many-IP flood.
